name: invisible-playwright-mcp
description: AI browser agent: browses, clicks, types, and reads real web pages from plain-English instructions.

interface.shortDescription: A real browser for your agent: it navigates, clicks, types, reads and screenshots pages the way a person would.
interface.longDescription:
invisible-playwright-mcp gives Codex a real browser to drive. The tools navigate, click, type, read and screenshot pages the way a person would, on a patched Firefox engine.

The engine, about a quarter of a gigabyte, is downloaded once by the server itself the first time it starts, outside this bundle. While that download is in flight, browser_open answers with its progress instead of opening a browser.
defaultPrompt: Go to example.com and tell me the main heading on the page.
